subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own syncing Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The user-visible bug is real from source inspection, but the implementation choice affects third-party persistence ownership, operator configuration, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Approve an opt-in Open WebUI sync boundary
options.body: Add a documented, version-aware integration path that mirrors future Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history and requires live proof before merge.

options.title: Expose a plugin/API seam only
options.body: Keep core from knowing Open WebUI storage details and require an Open WebUI plugin or external adapter to own the mirror behavior.

options.title: Declare co-editing unsupported
options.body: Document that OpenClaw can share model/session context with Open WebUI but does not write Open WebUI's visible chat history.

recommendation.title: Approve an opt-in Open WebUI sync boundary
recommendation.body: Add a documented, version-aware integration path that mirrors future Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history and requires live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway chat/session behavior and the core-vs-integration product boundary where recent history points to this area owner.
